title: Baernstein's norm-ratio conjecture for polynomials with unimodular roots
statement:
Let $Q(z)=1+z^n$, where $n$ is a positive integer, and let $\|\cdot\|_s$ denote the corresponding quasi-norm on the unit circle. **Baernstein's conjecture.** For every $0\leq s\leq t\leq\infty$ and every non-constant polynomial $p$ whose roots all lie on the unit circle,

$$
\frac{\|p\|_s}{\|Q\|_s}\leq\frac{\|p\|_t}{\|Q\|_t}.
$$

The paper attributes this conjecture to A. Baernstein II and explains that it would imply the entropy conjecture. Its general status is not resolved in the source.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.09718

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2018).
source_name: Jim Agler and John E. McCarthy, “The Krzyż Conjecture and an Entropy Conjecture”, arXiv:1803.09718 (2018).
